comment: Third-party skills, MCP servers and subagents are LISTED here, never copied
into this repo. No vendor/ directory, no sync script, no pinned shas, no
licence matrix. An entry is a pointer plus the setup steps a student needs,
exactly like a third-party MCP entry. build.mjs merges these into
registry.json alongside the skills this repo actually owns.

sources.name: PDF
sources.description: Read, extract, split, merge, fill, rotate and OCR PDF files. Useful alongside exam-prep when a student has a past paper as a scanned PDF rather than as text.

steps: Clone https://github.com/anthropics/skills or download the skills/pdf directory.
Copy skills/pdf into your agent's skills directory (~/.claude/skills/pdf for Claude Code).
Install its Python dependencies: pip install pypdf pdfplumber.
Start a new session and ask your agent to work with a PDF.

accesses: PDF files you point it at
your local shell, to run Python PDF tooling

notes: Listed rather than shipped for the usual reason, made concrete: this skill
is source-available, not open source, so vendoring it into an MIT repo
would be a licence problem. Not offered on the studyhub platform because
the app injects a SKILL.md body and cannot execute the scripts this one needs.
